paper_title: APT Improving Specialist LLM Performance with Weakness Case Acquisition   and Iterative Preference Training
caption: The exploration of hyperparameters.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between a parameter denoted as alpha and an accuracy metric. The x-axis is labeled “α” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4 with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 22.75 to 23.75 with tick labels at 0.25 intervals. A single teal-colored line, labeled “Dolly” in the legend, represents the relationship between these two variables; it begins at a value of approximately 22.75 when α is 0, increases to a peak of 23.70 when α is 1, then decreases to a value of approximately 23.30 when α is 2, and finally declines to 22.80 when α is 4. Circular markers are present at each data point along the line.
